description: This file defines the interface OpenmrsSerializer for serialization of objects within the OpenMRS platform, including methods for serializing objects to Strings and deserializing Strings back into objects. It provides the contract that implementing classes must follow for object serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: OpenmrsSerializer
classes.description: An interface that provides method signatures for serializing objects to strings and deserializing strings back into objects, used for implementing custom serialization mechanisms within OpenMRS.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a given object into a string representation that can be stored or transmitted.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts a serialized string back into an object of the specified class.
